candidates.change_summary: Replace withdrawal of the full contract balance with a withdrawal of 1 wei.
Delete the withdrawal call so withdrawAll performs no transfer and leaves the contract balance untouched.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can trigger withdrawal of the full balance.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners pass the modifier, changing who can execute withdrawAll.
Delete the require statement so the modifier imposes no restriction and anyone can call withdrawAll.
Replace the fixed _value transfer with a transfer of the entire contract balance.
Use a low-level call instead of transfer, forwarding all remaining gas.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw becomes a no-op that reverts nothing and sends no ether.
Send to the contract owner instead of msg.sender.
Invert the access check so only non-owners may execute guarded functions like withdraw.
Remove the require check so the modifier imposes no restriction, letting anyone call withdraw.
